title: fix: calendar duplicate button, broken event click, hardcoded record count
body:
Calendar page has a duplicate "New Event" button (page-level + calendar-internal), event clicks are silently dropped, and the "12 records" footer is hardcoded English. ### Remove duplicate "New Event" button Stop passing `onAddClick` to `CalendarView` from both `ObjectCalendar` and `calendar-view-renderer`. The page-level "New" button in `ObjectView` already handles creation. ### Fix event click propagation `ObjectCalendarRenderer` was swallowing all props from `SchemaRenderer`, including `onRowClick` from ListView. `ObjectGridRenderer` already does `({ schema, ...props }) => ` — calendar wasn't doing this. ```tsx // Before: onRowClick from ListView never reaches ObjectCalendar const ObjectCalendarRenderer = ({ schema }) => { return ; }; // After: forward props, but exclude data/loading to avoid // short-circuiting ObjectCalendar's internal data fetching const ObjectCalendarRenderer = ({ schema, data: _data, loading: _loading, ...props }) => { return ; }; ``` `data`/`loading` must be excluded because ListView passes an initially-empty array that would short-circuit ObjectCalendar's `useEffect` fetch and never re-run (deps don't include `rest.data`). ### Internationalize record count in ListView - Added `list.recordCount` / `list.recordCountOne` keys to all 11 locale files - Added `useListViewTranslation()` safe wrapper (same pattern as `useCalendarTranslation()`) with English defaults when no `I18nProvider` is present - `useObjectTranslation` doesn't throw without a provider — it returns keys verbatim, so the wrapper tests the return value rather than catching
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 日历页「新建」按钮重复 & 事件点击无响应 & 部分国际化问题 > ## 1. 右上角重复"新建"按钮 > - 现在有两个新建按钮：「+ 新建」（右上角页面级，只保留这个）和「+ 新建事件」（日历区域内部，需要移除）。 > - 建议：只保留页面右上角"新建"按钮，移除/隐藏日历内的"新建事件"按钮。 > > ## 2. 日历事件依然无法点击 > - 当前在月视图、周视图等点击蓝色事件卡片（如"Design dashboard widg..."）没有任何反馈。 > - 代码逻辑疑似在`calendar-view-renderer.tsx`中仍未正确派发`onEventClick`/`onAction`（建议彻底移除 `if (schema.onEventClick)` 条件，始终向上传递事件）。 > - 希望修复后点击任何日历中的事件都能正常弹出详情或跳转页面。 > > ## 3. 其它国际化细节 > - 日历底部"12 records"依然未进行本地化，页面应根据 locale 动态切换。 > - 建议排查所有硬编码英文提示，做国际化处理。 > > --- > > **截图复现：** > > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
